failure_reason: Claude-specific full-site robots.txt disallow. https://www.tavolashop.com/robots.txt contains an '# AI Crawlers - Block' section with 'User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: /' AND 'User-agent: Claude-Web / Disallow: /' (alongside GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, CCBot, Amazonbot, PerplexityBot, YouBot, cohere-ai, Google-Extended). Per brief section 5 this is a mandatory STOP, so no category extraction was performed. Note this is a POLICY CHANGE since the prior Home-Decor pass, which read the file from a Wayback snapshot and found only 'User-agent: GPTBot / Disallow: /' with no Claude entry. The site itself is technically reachable (see notes) - the block is legal/policy, not technical.
notes: ACCESS: opened https://www.tavolashop.com/robots.txt and https://www.tavolashop.com/ae-en/ in my own Chrome tab (browser connector only; no curl/requests/WebFetch/proxy at any point). Both first served the Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' managed-challenge interstitial (Ray ID a2df41827959792f). Diagnosis: document.visibilityState was 'hidden' and the challenge HTML was growing but not completing - Chrome's background-tab timer throttling was starving the Cloudflare challenge script, not the site refusing us. Bringing the tab to the foreground (screenshot) let the challenge complete immediately and the real storefront rendered: title '#1 Stop for Bakeware, Cookware & Appliances in UAE | Tavola'. This is worth recording for other UAE/Cloudflare targets in this batch: a stuck 'Just a moment...' in a background MCP tab is usually a visibility problem, not a wall. ROBOTS CHECK (brief section 5, done before any extraction): fetched /robots.txt same-origin from the loaded page. 'User-agent: *' restricts only Magento system routes (app/, bin/, checkout/, customer/, wishlist/, index.php/, REST/SOAP, backup file extensions) and does NOT disallow catalogue browsing. However the file ends with an explicit '# AI Crawlers - Block' block listing ClaudeBot and Claude-Web with 'Disallow: /' each. Two Claude tokens named with a full-site disallow = the section 5 STOP condition. Verbatim text saved to w169_robots_evidence.txt. WHAT WAS SEEN BEFORE STOPPING (not a furniture conclusion, recorded only for the orchestrator's benefit): the rendered home page mega-menu exposes 274 unique /ae-en/ category paths under departments Appliances, Cookware, Bakeware, Kitchen Tools, Coffee & Tea, Table & Home, On The Go, Outdoor, plus Deals/Brands/Classes/Recipes. Tavola is a kitchenware/bakeware/cookware/tableware specialist and no 'Furniture' department appears in the top nav. That observation is NOT an earned absence proof - the brief section 6 procedure (category sitemap, per-department tile strips, furniture slug scan, discrimination-checked search) was deliberately NOT run because robots.txt forbids it. Also note /sitemap.xml returned no <loc> entries and robots.txt carries no Sitemap: directive. NO extraction, no counts, no product data were taken from the site after the robots finding. rows is empty because nothing was extracted, NOT because absence was proven.
